messages:
Marta - Docs: FYI starting a quick PR to fix the model-card guidance for embedding precision + an SDK auth snippet that points to the wrong KMS guide. Not urgent but want to get it merged before next release.
Sam - ML Eng: thanks — which model cards are affected?
Marta - Docs: Primarily vega13b and polaris13b cards. Embedding section currently says "high precision (fp16) recommended" which is misleading for our embed pipeline — we usually run int8 quantized variants for embeddings.
Josh - SDK: ugh that broken auth snippet is my fault, I copy-pasted the old KMS link. Which file?
Marta - Docs: docs/models/vega13b.md and docs/models/polaris13b.md. The SDK snippet at docs/sdk/snippets/auth.md links to /docs/security/kms-old instead of the new /security/kms-integration page.
Tanya - QA: flagged a failing example in the embed throughput test harness yesterday, might be related. The test expects 0.85 tokens/ms but we saw 0.47 when int8 was used with the default batching config.
Sam - ML Eng: that throughput delta sounds like batching + prefix caching mismatch. We should update the guidance to: "For embedding-only workloads, prefer quantized int8 models + batching window=10ms; expect ~0.4-0.9 tokens/ms depending on GPU class and sequence length." Keep it advisory.
Kiran - Product: can we add a short note about cross-region variance? Customers running in EU->US see a ~10-30% latency change for small batches. Worth mentioning in the card.
Marta - Docs: good call. I'll draft a one-paragraph blurb for cross-region variance and include the suggested numbers.
Josh - SDK: I'll fix the auth snippet and point it at the new KMS doc, and I'll add a tiny code sample showing token refresh in python. Preview: 
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
# refresh if expired
c.auth.refresh_if_needed()
```
Does that look OK?
Sam - ML Eng: looks fine. Add a note: "use cached credentials for high QPS embedding workloads".
Tanya - QA: I'll run the embed throughput suite against the int8 configs after the change. ETA ~in 30m.
Marta - Docs: PR is at https://git.internal.redwood/repo/docs/pulls/3921 — small changes: wording, two links, and the code snippet. Please comment there if you want a reword.
doc-bot: CI started for PR #3921 — docs lint, linkcheck, snippet-tests.
Josh - SDK: pushed a commit that corrects the link and adds the python snippet (force-pushed to the branch).
Sam - ML Eng: I updated the model-card benchmark section with a short table of representative throughput numbers for gpus: A10G int8 = 0.8 tok/ms; A100 fp16 = 1.4 tok/ms; t4 int8 = 0.35 tok/ms. Kept wording careful: "representative, not guaranteed".
Tanya - QA: linkcheck failed in CI (old KMS link still present in one hidden include). Investigating.
Marta - Docs: found the hidden include: docs/_includes/security_links.html — updating now.
Kiran - Product: pls add a sentence tying the guidance to cost tradeoffs: int8 is cheaper but may slightly alter similarity scores; we should recommend small evals before switching models.
Marta - Docs: added that note and a tiny eval checklist: 1) sample pairs 2) compute cosine delta 3) check business thresholds.
Tanya - QA: re-ran snippet-tests locally, all passing. CI retriggered and now linkcheck is green.
doc-bot: CI passed for PR #3921 — all checks OK.
Josh - SDK: can someone approve the snippet change?
Sam - ML Eng: approving from infra side — looks good.
Kiran - Product: approved.
Marta - Docs: merged main. Thanks all! I'll follow up with a short release note for next week's changelog.
Tanya - QA: quick note — after merge, I ran the embed harness cross-region and saw the expected 12% median latency bump EU->US for small batches. Added result to the PR comments.
Marta - Docs: added the cross-region stat to the card and changelog note. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
